questions.question: Explain the following items with examples: (a) Fixed Assets (b) Current Liability (c) Contingent Assets / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• a) Fixed Assets -Fixed assets are long-term assets acquired for use in business and not
  • for resale.
  • Examples: Land, Building, Plant, Machinery, Furniture.
  • (b) Current Liability -Liabilities payable within one accounting year or operating cycle.
  • Examples: Sundry Creditors, Bills Payable, Outstanding Expenses,
  • To Bad debts 3000
  • Add : further Bad debts
  • 2000
  • 5000
  • Add: New provision
  • 60000x 5% 3000
  • 8000
  • Less: old provision 3000
  • 5000
  • (c) Contingent Assets - Possible assets arising from past events whose existence
  • depends upon uncertain future events.
  • Examples: Claim under litigation, Insurance claim under dispute, Compensation claim
  • awaiting court decision

questions.question: Calculate unrealised profit , pass the journal entry to adjust it, and Balance sheet disclosure in the following case. a) Department X transferred goods to Department Y at a profit of 25% on cost. The cost of goods was Rs 40000. At year-end, Department Y‘s closing stock includes 50% of thes goods. b) Department A transferred goods to Department B . Closing stock of department B inclues Rs.24000 from Department A .Profit margin was 20% on Sales / [CO2]
questions.solution_html: • 3.5 marks each for two cases Case 1: Unrealised profit = 25% on Cost Since 50% of goods remain unsold = Closing stock portion (cost)= 50% of ₹40,000 = ₹20,000 Therefore, Unrealised Profit = 25% of ₹20,000 = ₹5,000 (1.5 marks) Journal Entry : General Profit & Loss A/C-------- Dr 5000 To Stock reserve 5000 ( 1 mark) In the Balance Sheet, Stock Reserve ₹5,000 is shown as a deduction from closing stock of Department Y. ( 1 mark) Case II: Unrealised profit = 20% on Sales Closing stock portion = ₹ 24,000 Therefore, Unrealised Profit = 20% of ₹ 24,000 = ₹ 4,800 (1.5 marks) Journal Entry : General Profit & Loss A/C------- Dr 4800 To Stock reserve 4800 ( 1 mark) In the Balance Sheet, Stock Reserve ₹4800 is shown as a deduction from closing stock of Department B. ( 1 mark)
